mappings.displayName: Pulmonary optimization before elective incisional-hernia repair
mappings.learningObjective: For a stable adult with a reducible, nonemergent incisional hernia and poorly controlled COPD, select pulmonary optimization before finalizing elective repair.

mappings.displayName: Initial imaging of a palpable breast mass under age 30
mappings.learningObjective: Select targeted breast ultrasound as the initial imaging study for the scoped adult patient younger than 30 with a new palpable breast mass.

mappings.displayName: Management of an asymptomatic simple breast cyst
mappings.learningObjective: Select no cyst-directed procedure for an imaging-concordant simple breast cyst that is not painful or bothersome.

mappings.displayName: Initial treatment of a painful simple breast cyst
mappings.learningObjective: Offer needle aspiration for symptom relief from a persistently painful or bothersome, imaging-concordant simple breast cyst.
Recognize canonical EBV-associated malignancies while preserving the boundary that an association is neither universal across every tumor nor an individual cancer-risk prediction.

mappings.displayName: Apply standard Milan criteria to HCC referral
mappings.learningObjective: Apply standard Milan tumor-number, size, macrovascular-invasion, and extrahepatic-disease criteria to recognize when HCC tumor burden supports transplant-center evaluation without treating the criteria as automatic listing.
Recognize the characteristic superficial breast or chest-wall venous cord and its underlying superficial thrombophlebitis.

mappings.displayName: Selective imaging evaluation of suspected Mondor disease
mappings.learningObjective: Select targeted Doppler ultrasound when the superficial venous diagnosis is uncertain and age-appropriate diagnostic breast imaging when focal symptoms require evaluation for underlying pathology.

mappings.displayName: Supportive management of uncomplicated Mondor disease
mappings.learningObjective: Use supportive care for concordant uncomplicated Mondor disease while recognizing findings that require renewed evaluation.

mappings.displayName: Female sex and perioperative mortality after elective AAA repair
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize that women have higher observed perioperative mortality after elective intact AAA repair at the group level, while preserving the boundary that this association does not determine an individual outcome or select a repair approach.

mappings.displayName: Initial active surveillance for selected desmoid tumors
mappings.learningObjective: Choose specialist active surveillance as the initial strategy for newly diagnosed, stable or minimally symptomatic desmoid disease without critical threat or meaningful functional deterioration.

mappings.displayName: Surgical option for progressing symptomatic abdominal-wall desmoid
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize function-preserving resection after multidisciplinary review as an option for progressing symptomatic abdominal-wall desmoid when expected morbidity is acceptably low.

mappings.displayName: Distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy for resectable tail adenocarcinoma
mappings.learningObjective: Select oncologic distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy when a fit patient with pancreatic-tail adenocarcinoma has been judged resectable and is proceeding to surgery.
Recognize Felty syndrome from rheumatoid arthritis with persistent neutropenia, usually with splenomegaly, after important alternative causes have been excluded.
Select specialist-monitored methotrexate as the usual first-line disease-modifying treatment and distinguish bridging therapy from the long-term plan.

mappings.displayName: Splenectomy for medically refractory Felty syndrome
mappings.learningObjective: Consider splenectomy only after recurrent infections persist despite adequate medical therapy and multidisciplinary review.
Order paired 24-hour urine and serum calcium-creatinine measurements before parathyroid localization when FHH is suspected.
Use relative hypocalciuria, family context, and appropriate genetic evaluation without treating a low clearance ratio as independently diagnostic.

mappings.displayName: Avoid unnecessary parathyroid surgery in FHH
mappings.learningObjective: Reassure and observe a patient with confirmed uncomplicated FHH rather than performing routine parathyroid surgery.
Recognize acute lymphangitis from a distal skin entry site, a tender erythematous streak extending proximally, and tender regional lymph nodes.
Select the owner-approved initial management category for a completed incidental gallbladder-polyp ultrasound profile.
For the approved resectable distal common-bile-duct profile, select hospital HPB referral for pancreaticoduodenectomy and distinguish the represented distal location.

mappings.displayName: Obstructive jaundice, vitamin K, and coagulopathy
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize the approved relationship between obstructive jaundice, reduced vitamin K absorption, and vitamin K-related coagulopathy.

mappings.displayName: HCC resection selection in compensated cirrhosis
mappings.learningObjective: For the approved favorable compensated-cirrhosis profile, select hospital HPB-surgery referral for hepatic resection evaluation without treating Child-Pugh A status or Milan classification alone as sufficient.
Recognize the splenic hilum as the most common location represented for an accessory spleen without treating one location as a complete splenectomy plan.
For the approved persistent-hemolysis presentation after total splenectomy, reassess and evaluate for functioning accessory splenic tissue without relying on MCV, RDW, or Howell-Jolly bodies alone.
For confirmed functioning accessory splenic tissue causing persistent symptomatic hemolysis, refer to hospital surgery for removal without treating incidental tissue as an indication.
Identify pouchitis as the approved common inflammatory pouch complication after IPAA for ulcerative colitis.

mappings.displayName: Type IVA congenital bile duct cyst anatomy
mappings.learningObjective: Identify Type IVA as the approved combined intrahepatic and extrahepatic cystic-dilatation pattern.
Identify high-risk human papillomavirus as the approved etiologic association of anal HSIL.
Recognize the approved MEN2A pattern of medullary thyroid carcinoma, pheochromocytoma, and primary hyperparathyroidism.
Recognize that a functioning pheochromocytoma must be excluded or addressed before thyroid intervention in the approved MEN2A scope.
When both are indicated for a functioning pheochromocytoma, establish alpha blockade before adding beta blockade.

mappings.displayName: Management of a clearly characterized asymptomatic colonic lipoma
mappings.learningObjective: Choose no lipoma-directed treatment or dedicated surveillance for a clearly characterized asymptomatic colonic lipoma and recognize features that make that pathway inapplicable.
Identify vitamin C as a cofactor for proline and lysine hydroxylation in collagen biosynthesis and connect inadequate hydroxylation with reduced collagen stability and impaired healing.

mappings.displayName: Pathologic recognition of gastric MALT lymphoma
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize gastric MALT lymphoma from integrated small B-cell morphology, lymphoepithelial lesions, and compatible immunophenotyping while avoiding diagnosis from CD20 alone.

mappings.displayName: H. pylori eradication as initial treatment for localized gastric MALT lymphoma
mappings.learningObjective: Select H. pylori eradication as initial treatment for the classic localized low-grade presentation and preserve confirmation and response-reassessment boundaries.

mappings.displayName: Confirmatory gastric-emptying testing for suspected gastroparesis
mappings.learningObjective: Select four-hour solid-meal gastric emptying scintigraphy to document delayed gastric emptying after mechanical obstruction has been excluded.

mappings.displayName: Avoid routine prophylactic splenectomy in proximal gastric cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Preserve the spleen during curative gastrectomy for proximal gastric adenocarcinoma when there is no greater-curvature invasion, direct splenic invasion, or suspected splenic-hilar disease.

mappings.displayName: High-risk peptic-ulcer stigmata requiring endoscopic hemostasis
mappings.learningObjective: Distinguish active spurting, active oozing, and a nonbleeding visible vessel from low-risk clean-base or flat-spot findings when deciding whether endoscopic hemostasis is required.

mappings.displayName: Endoscopic hemostasis modality selection for peptic-ulcer bleeding
mappings.learningObjective: Select an accepted definitive thermal or mechanical modality, recognize that epinephrine is never definitive monotherapy, and apply the conventional epinephrine-plus-definitive-modality pathway without making all monotherapies universally wrong.
For the approved completed-imaging distal-obstruction profile, select the constrained combined endoscopic tissue-evaluation plan without treating CA 19-9 as confirmation.

Recognize an adult clinical pattern that supports Graves disease: symptoms compatible with thyroid-hormone excess together with diffuse thyroid enlargement and characteristic eye or pretibial skin findings when present, without requiring every feature in every patient.

mappings.displayName: TRAb diagnostic support for Graves disease
mappings.learningObjective: Use TRAb as etiologic support for Graves disease when a patient already has biochemical thyrotoxicosis; distinguish thyroid function from cause and recognize that a negative TRAb result does not fully exclude Graves disease.

mappings.displayName: RAI evaluation for recurrent Graves hyperthyroidism
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize recurrent hyperthyroidism after antithyroid-drug withdrawal as a setting where RAI evaluation is a reasonable counseling option, while retaining surgery and antithyroid-drug treatment as preference-sensitive alternatives.
Recognize current pregnancy as a contraindication to RAI treatment for Graves disease while continuing appropriate endocrine and obstetric assessment without RAI during pregnancy.
Recognize current breastfeeding as a contraindication to therapeutic iodine-131 for Graves disease and recognize the pre-treatment counseling boundary for feeding the current child.

mappings.displayName: RAI avoidance with active moderate-to-severe TED
mappings.learningObjective: Generally avoid therapeutic iodine-131 in ordinary Graves treatment counseling when specialist assessment documents active moderate-to-severe thyroid eye disease.
Select abdominal ultrasound as the initial imaging study for a stable outpatient with recurrent symptoms compatible with uncomplicated gallstones.
Use compatible recurrent symptoms and uncomplicated ultrasound-confirmed gallstones to support elective surgical assessment and cholecystectomy counseling.
Choose observation and counseling for uncomplicated incidental gallstones in an asymptomatic adult without suspicious gallbladder features.

mappings.displayName: Noncontrast CT for unresolved suspected stone disease
mappings.learningObjective: Select noncontrast CT to resolve stone presence, location, and obstruction in a stable nonpregnant adult after indeterminate ultrasound.

mappings.displayName: Metabolic evaluation after recurrent kidney stones
mappings.learningObjective: Select stone analysis when available together with urine and blood metabolic assessment for prevention planning after recurrent confirmed stone disease.

mappings.displayName: Initial serology for suspected celiac disease
mappings.learningObjective: Select tTG-IgA with total-IgA context as a usual initial serologic assessment while a patient with compatible symptoms continues eating gluten.
Select upper endoscopy with duodenal biopsies as the usual confirmation step for an adult with compatible positive celiac serology and adequate IgA.
Recommend a gluten-free diet with dietitian support after celiac disease is confirmed in the completed diagnostic pathway.

mappings.displayName: Diagnostic colonoscopy after a positive FIT
mappings.learningObjective: Select diagnostic colonoscopy after a positive screening FIT while recognizing that the stool result alone does not diagnose colorectal cancer.

mappings.displayName: Histologic confirmation of a colorectal lesion
mappings.learningObjective: Identify histologic examination of sampled lesion tissue as the confirming evidence after colonoscopy identifies a suspicious colorectal lesion.
Choose ferritin and complementary iron studies to determine whether iron deficiency explains established anemia without relying on a numeric threshold.
Recommend suitability assessment for upper endoscopy and colonoscopy in adult men or postmenopausal patients with otherwise unexplained confirmed iron-deficiency anemia.

mappings.displayName: MRI characterization of a concerning extremity mass
mappings.learningObjective: Select dedicated extremity MRI before biopsy for a deep, enlarging, or ultrasound-indeterminate soft-tissue mass while recognizing that imaging does not prove sarcoma.

mappings.displayName: Specialist-planned biopsy of a suspicious soft-tissue mass
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a suspicious extremity mass to an experienced sarcoma team for planned image-guided core biopsy that preserves the future surgical approach.

mappings.displayName: FNA selection for a suspicious thyroid nodule
mappings.learningObjective: Select ultrasound-guided FNA after normal TSH and ultrasound findings meeting biopsy criteria in the scoped stable outpatient pathway.
Recognize that capsular or vascular invasion distinguishing follicular adenoma from carcinoma requires histologic evaluation rather than follicular cytology alone.
Use repeat serum calcium with intact PTH to establish the biochemical pattern before localization planning in the scoped stable outpatient pathway.

mappings.displayName: Surgical assessment for complicated primary hyperparathyroidism
mappings.learningObjective: Recommend parathyroid surgical assessment for biochemically confirmed primary hyperparathyroidism with authored renal or skeletal complications.

mappings.displayName: Clinical recognition of acute anal fissure
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize an uncomplicated acute anal fissure from recent defecation-related pain, scant bleeding, and a superficial midline tear.

mappings.displayName: Initial conservative care for acute anal fissure
mappings.learningObjective: Select stool-regulating fiber, fluids, soft formed stools, and sitz baths as initial care for a typical uncomplicated acute fissure.
Select anoscopy to define local canal anatomy after an appropriate broader evaluation in a stable patient with suspected internal hemorrhoids.

mappings.displayName: Office banding for persistent internal hemorrhoids
mappings.learningObjective: Select office rubber-band ligation for uncomplicated bleeding or prolapsing internal hemorrhoids that persist after conservative care.

mappings.displayName: Upper endoscopy for persistent esophageal dysphagia
mappings.learningObjective: Select upper-GI endoscopy with appropriate esophageal biopsies for stable persistent esophageal dysphagia with a structural or mucosal concern.
Recognize Barrett esophagus from a sampled columnar esophageal segment with specialized intestinal metaplasia.
Recognize achalasia from absent peristalsis and impaired esophagogastric-junction relaxation without relying on an unsupported numeric threshold.
Discuss sentinel lymph-node biopsy for pathological regional staging of intermediate-thickness clinically node-negative melanoma alongside definitive excision planning.
Select targeted ultrasound to characterize an uncertain superficial collection after benign breast excision.

mappings.displayName: Observation of an uncomplicated postoperative seroma
mappings.learningObjective: Observe a small simple asymptomatic postoperative seroma without infection, wound tension, implant, or functional limitation.

mappings.displayName: Clinical recognition of chronic pilonidal sinus
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize chronic pilonidal sinus disease from recurrent natal-cleft drainage and characteristic midline pits without a current abscess.

mappings.displayName: Off-midline closure planning for pilonidal disease
mappings.learningObjective: Plan an off-midline closure when excision with primary closure has already been selected for chronic pilonidal disease.

mappings.displayName: Targeted ultrasound for suspected lactational breast abscess
mappings.learningObjective: Select targeted breast ultrasound for a persistent focal inflammatory breast mass during lactation.

mappings.displayName: Selected drainage of a lactational breast abscess
mappings.learningObjective: Choose image-guided drainage with culture and individualized antibiotic care for a suitable uncomplicated lactational abscess while preserving feeding when contact precautions are met.
Select laryngeal visualization for persistent voice change after thyroid surgery.
Localize loss of high pitch and projection with preserved ordinary vocal-fold mobility to external superior laryngeal nerve and cricothyroid dysfunction.

mappings.displayName: Contrast swallow for suspected Zenker diverticulum
mappings.learningObjective: Select contrast swallow with fluoroscopy for a classic proximal pouch presentation.
Recognize a posterior mucosa-and-submucosa pouch above the cricopharyngeus as Zenker anatomy.

mappings.displayName: Resting ABI for suspected peripheral arterial disease
mappings.learningObjective: Select resting ankle-brachial index testing for classic stable claudication symptoms and examination findings.
Select supervised or structured exercise before invasive therapy for stable functionally limiting claudication after risk reduction is addressed.

mappings.displayName: Three-site skeletal assessment in asymptomatic primary hyperparathyroidism
mappings.learningObjective: Select lumbar-spine, hip, and distal forearm DXA for skeletal assessment after primary hyperparathyroidism is confirmed.

mappings.displayName: Age-based surgical assessment in asymptomatic primary hyperparathyroidism
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize age under 50 years as an independent reason to discuss parathyroid surgery after confirmed asymptomatic disease.

mappings.displayName: ACTH classification after confirmed endogenous Cushing syndrome
mappings.learningObjective: Select plasma ACTH to classify the cause after endogenous hypercortisolism is already confirmed.
Select adrenal imaging for the suppressed-ACTH branch of confirmed endogenous Cushing syndrome.

mappings.displayName: MRCP duct assessment for an indeterminate pancreatic cyst
mappings.learningObjective: Use MRI/MRCP to assess communication between an indeterminate pancreatic cyst and the main duct.
Recognize a body or tail cyst without main-duct communication as MCN-compatible without claiming definitive histology or automatic resection.

mappings.displayName: Preoperative cross-sectional staging for colon cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Select contrast-enhanced CT of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis before treatment planning for confirmed colon cancer.

mappings.displayName: Oncologic regional resection for colon cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Select resection of the tumor-bearing colon with its regional lymphatic drainage for localized resectable colon cancer.

mappings.displayName: Multimodal response assessment after rectal cancer treatment
mappings.learningObjective: Select combined digital rectal examination, endoscopy, and rectal-protocol MRI after neoadjuvant treatment.

mappings.displayName: Selected watch-and-wait after clinical complete response
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize intensive-surveillance watch-and-wait as an acceptable nonsurgical option for a fully informed adherent patient with a clinical complete response in an experienced program.

mappings.displayName: Confirmatory vascular imaging after carotid duplex
mappings.learningObjective: Select confirmatory CT angiography after duplex suggests severe symptomatic carotid stenosis.

mappings.displayName: Endarterectomy assessment for severe symptomatic carotid stenosis
mappings.learningObjective: Select prompt carotid endarterectomy assessment with best medical therapy for a suitable patient with severe ipsilateral symptomatic stenosis.

mappings.displayName: Germline polyposis evaluation after diffuse adenomas
mappings.learningObjective: Select hereditary counseling and APC/MUTYH germline testing after colonoscopy establishes diffuse adenomatous polyposis.

mappings.displayName: IPAA referral for uncontrolled rectal FAP burden
mappings.learningObjective: Select restorative proctocolectomy/IPAA referral when rectal adenomas cannot be controlled endoscopically and restoration is appropriate.

mappings.displayName: MRI mapping for recurrent complex fistula
mappings.learningObjective: Select pelvic MRI to map recurrent complex fistula anatomy.

mappings.displayName: Sphincter-preserving staged planning for high fistula
mappings.learningObjective: Choose loose-seton referral and staged sphincter-preserving planning for high transsphincteric anatomy.
Select colonoscopy after first recovered complicated diverticulitis without recent adequate examination.
Discuss elective sigmoid resection using recovery burden and patient context rather than episode count.

mappings.displayName: Biopsy with CT and MRI staging of an anal-canal lesion
mappings.learningObjective: Arrange tissue biopsy with CT chest/abdomen/pelvis and pelvic MRI for a suspicious anal-canal lesion.

mappings.displayName: Chemoradiation referral for localized anal-canal SCC
mappings.learningObjective: Refer nonmetastatic anal-canal SCC after CT and pelvic MRI for definitive chemoradiation planning.

mappings.displayName: Venous duplex for suspected postoperative DVT
mappings.learningObjective: Select prompt venous duplex/compression ultrasound for new unilateral postoperative leg symptoms.
Select finite anticoagulation planning for a first uncomplicated major-surgery-provoked proximal DVT when safe.

mappings.displayName: HIV and hepatitis-C evaluation in presumed ITP
mappings.learningObjective: Select HIV and hepatitis-C testing before concluding primary ITP in compatible isolated thrombocytopenia.

mappings.displayName: Deferring elective splenectomy in persistent ITP
mappings.learningObjective: Defer elective splenectomy when feasible in stable persistent ITP of only several months.

mappings.displayName: EUS core and molecular evaluation of selected gastric GIST
mappings.learningObjective: Select EUS-guided core tissue and molecular testing when a challenging gastric mass may receive preoperative targeted therapy.

mappings.displayName: Mutation-guided neoadjuvant planning for challenging GIST
mappings.learningObjective: Select neoadjuvant imatinib only for an imatinib-sensitive GIST when shrinkage is expected to reduce operative morbidity.

mappings.displayName: Multiphasic MRI characterization of hepatic adenoma
mappings.learningObjective: Select multiphasic liver MRI to characterize a suspected hepatic adenoma while respecting imaging limitations.

mappings.displayName: Resection planning for hepatic adenoma in men
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a stable man with a characterized hepatic adenoma for elective resection planning regardless of lesion size.

mappings.displayName: CTA evaluation of chronic mesenteric ischemia
mappings.learningObjective: Select mesenteric CTA for compatible chronic postprandial symptoms after reasonable exclusion of alternatives.

mappings.displayName: Revascularization referral for symptomatic multivessel CMI
mappings.learningObjective: Refer symptomatic multivessel occlusive chronic mesenteric ischemia for expert revascularization planning.

mappings.displayName: Prepared ARR screening for primary aldosteronism
mappings.learningObjective: Select aldosterone and renin testing with ARR after potassium and medication preparation in resistant hypertension with spontaneous hypokalemia.

mappings.displayName: CT and AVS before lateralized adrenal surgery
mappings.learningObjective: Select adrenal CT plus AVS before deciding unilateral surgery in an appropriate adult with confirmed primary aldosteronism.

mappings.displayName: MRCP for an intermediate-risk duct stone
mappings.learningObjective: Select MRCP for stable intermediate-likelihood choledocholithiasis when the local route favors noninvasive imaging.

mappings.displayName: Therapeutic ERCP referral for a confirmed duct stone
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a confirmed duct stone for therapeutic ERCP when the selected local pathway clears the duct before cholecystectomy.
Select hepatobiliary-contrast MRCP after CT to localize a stable postoperative bile leak and assess duct continuity.

mappings.displayName: ERCP stent referral for a persistent minor bile leak
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a persistent minor leak with preserved duct continuity for ERCP and plastic-stent treatment.

mappings.displayName: Off-PPI reflux monitoring for unproven GERD
mappings.learningObjective: Order ambulatory reflux monitoring off PPI when normal endoscopy leaves GERD unproven before invasive therapy.
Order high-resolution manometry after objective reflux confirmation and before operative planning.

mappings.displayName: Completed Whipple triad in post-bariatric hypoglycemia
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize PBH when a spontaneous episode already documents symptoms, venous plasma hypoglycemia, and relief after correction.

mappings.displayName: Initial dietary care for post-bariatric hypoglycemia
mappings.learningObjective: Start specialist dietitian-led individualized dietary care for stable confirmed PBH.

mappings.displayName: Tumor MMR screening in colorectal cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Select tumor MMR IHC screening for a newly diagnosed colorectal cancer in the local universal-screening pathway.

mappings.displayName: Genetics counseling after suggestive tumor IHC
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a Lynch-suggestive MSH2/MSH6-loss tumor result for genetics counseling and germline-testing discussion.

mappings.displayName: Topical CCB for chronic anal fissure
mappings.learningObjective: Select topical CCB as the local first-line pharmacologic treatment for typical chronic anal fissure.

mappings.displayName: Selected LIS discussion after chronic-fissure medical treatment
mappings.learningObjective: Discuss LIS after failed medical treatment for selected chronic anal fissure without described continence risk.

mappings.displayName: Diagnostic biopsy of a suspicious keratinocyte lesion
mappings.learningObjective: Select adequate diagnostic biopsy for a suspicious lesion before cSCC risk-directed treatment.
Choose standard excision for low-risk cSCC and Mohs-capable referral for high-risk cSCC.
Obtain arterial assessment before selecting compression for a suspected venous leg ulcer.
Select compression therapy for a stable venous leg ulcer after returned arterial assessment supports its use.
Review indicated encapsulated-organism vaccines before elective splenectomy and coordinate them at least 14 days before surgery when possible.

mappings.displayName: Emergency action for fever with asplenia
mappings.learningObjective: Select immediate emergency assessment for a known asplenic patient with fever without outpatient test delay.
Select a 1-mg overnight dexamethasone suppression test to evaluate autonomous cortisol secretion in a stable adult with an adrenal incidentaloma.
Exclude pheochromocytoma biochemically before considering a management-changing biopsy of an indeterminate adrenal mass.

mappings.displayName: Full-thickness biopsy for suspected mammary Paget disease
mappings.learningObjective: Select full-thickness nipple-areolar skin biopsy for persistent unilateral changes suspicious for mammary Paget disease.

mappings.displayName: Underlying breast evaluation after mammary Paget diagnosis
mappings.learningObjective: Evaluate for underlying breast carcinoma with mammography and ultrasound after mammary Paget disease is confirmed.

mappings.displayName: Tissue confirmation of inflammatory breast cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Arrange breast core biopsy and staging for a rapid diffuse inflammatory breast presentation without an abscess.

mappings.displayName: Neoadjuvant sequence for stage III inflammatory breast cancer
mappings.learningObjective: Select neoadjuvant systemic therapy before modified radical mastectomy and postmastectomy radiation for stage III inflammatory breast cancer.
Select one-time abdominal ultrasound screening for a man age 65-75 who has ever smoked.

mappings.displayName: Elective repair evaluation for a 6-cm AAA
mappings.learningObjective: Refer an acceptable-risk patient with an asymptomatic 6-cm fusiform AAA for elective vascular repair evaluation.
Begin stable fecal incontinence care with dietary and medical measures tailored to stool consistency and bowel habits.

mappings.displayName: Endoanal ultrasound for sphincter repair planning
mappings.learningObjective: Select endoanal ultrasound when sphincter anatomy is needed for possible repair planning.

mappings.displayName: Active H. pylori testing for duodenal ulcer
mappings.learningObjective: Select a nonserologic active-infection test for H. pylori in uncomplicated duodenal ulcer disease.
Plan nonserologic confirmation of H. pylori eradication after treatment and the required washout intervals.
Select CT to confirm a first suspected diverticulitis presentation and assess for complications.

mappings.displayName: Selected supportive care for uncomplicated diverticulitis
mappings.learningObjective: Use outpatient supportive care without routine antibiotics for a carefully selected mild uncomplicated case.

mappings.displayName: Ultrasound for suspected thyroglossal duct cyst
mappings.learningObjective: Select neck and thyroid ultrasound for a stable suspected thyroglossal duct cyst.

mappings.displayName: Sistrunk referral for thyroglossal duct cyst
mappings.learningObjective: Refer a benign-characterized symptomatic thyroglossal duct cyst for elective Sistrunk evaluation.

mappings.displayName: Dynamic defecography for elusive rectal prolapse
mappings.learningObjective: Select dynamic defecography when suspected external rectal prolapse cannot be reproduced on examination.

mappings.displayName: Surgical referral for full-thickness rectal prolapse
mappings.learningObjective: Refer dynamically confirmed external full-thickness rectal prolapse for individualized colorectal surgical evaluation.

mappings.displayName: Multilevel esophageal biopsies for suspected EoE
mappings.learningObjective: Select upper endoscopy with adequate multilevel biopsies for suspected eosinophilic esophagitis.

mappings.displayName: Dilation with anti-inflammatory care for fibrostenotic EoE
mappings.learningObjective: Plan dilation together with anti-inflammatory care for symptomatic fibrostenotic eosinophilic esophagitis.

mappings.displayName: Core biopsy of a suspicious solid breast mass
mappings.learningObjective: Select image-guided core biopsy for an accessible solid breast mass categorized as suspicious on diagnostic imaging.
Avoid routine excision of an asymptomatic concordant core-proven fibroadenoma without atypia or phyllodes concern.
Select targeted soft-tissue ultrasound when examination cannot distinguish cellulitis from an abscess.

mappings.displayName: Drainage of a confirmed cutaneous abscess
mappings.learningObjective: Select incision and drainage as primary treatment for a confirmed uncomplicated cutaneous abscess.

mappings.displayName: Watchful waiting for selected inguinal hernia
mappings.learningObjective: Offer informed watchful waiting to a man with a reducible asymptomatic or minimally symptomatic inguinal hernia.

mappings.displayName: Timely elective repair planning for femoral hernia
mappings.learningObjective: Arrange timely elective repair evaluation for a stable reducible femoral hernia.
Identify an indirect inguinal hernia by its passage lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels through the deep ring.

mappings.displayName: Lateral femoral cutaneous nerve sensory pattern
mappings.learningObjective: Localize isolated anterolateral-thigh sensory symptoms after laparoscopic inguinal repair to the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve.

mappings.displayName: Laboratory assessment of high-output ileostomy losses
mappings.learningObjective: Assess renal function, electrolytes, and magnesium in stable high-output ileostomy follow-up.

mappings.displayName: Sodium-glucose oral rehydration for high-output ileostomy
mappings.learningObjective: Choose sodium-glucose oral rehydration rather than increased plain water for stable high-output ileostomy losses.

mappings.displayName: Prompt drainage of a perianal abscess
mappings.learningObjective: Arrange prompt incision and drainage of a clinically evident superficial perianal abscess.

mappings.displayName: Selective antibiotics after perianal abscess drainage
mappings.learningObjective: Omit routine antibiotics after adequate drainage in a healthy patient without cellulitis or systemic infection.

mappings.displayName: Continuation of a chronic beta blocker
mappings.learningObjective: Continue a tolerated chronic beta blocker through noncardiac surgery when no contraindication is present.
Avoid routine therapeutic-dose heparin bridging when warfarin is interrupted for selected nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.

mappings.displayName: Stop surgical prophylactic antibiotics after closure
mappings.learningObjective: Stop surgical antimicrobial prophylaxis after incision closure when no infection exists, even if a drain remains.

mappings.displayName: Extended VTE prophylaxis after selected cancer surgery
mappings.learningObjective: Use about four weeks of postoperative pharmacologic prophylaxis for a selected high-VTE-risk patient after major abdominal or pelvic cancer surgery.

mappings.displayName: Bladder scan for postoperative inability to void
mappings.learningObjective: Select bedside bladder scanning to assess suspected postoperative urinary retention.
Provide catheter decompression for symptomatic postoperative retention with a large retained volume.

mappings.displayName: Source control for superficial incisional infection
mappings.learningObjective: Open and drain a purulent superficial incisional infection with intact fascia.
Protect exposed bowel with a sterile moist covering and activate immediate emergency surgical transfer.

mappings.displayName: Recognize mechanical SBO on completed CT
mappings.learningObjective: Recognize mechanical SBO from a completed CT transition pattern without claiming imaging alone proves ischemia.
Send SBO with peritonitis or concern for ischemia for immediate surgical evaluation.
Recognize umbilical or epigastric hernia clinically and reserve imaging for uncertainty.
Refer a stable symptomatic primary midline hernia for individualized elective repair discussion.
Select disease-specific reflux duplex for symptomatic varicose veins.
Use findings, candidacy, and preference to choose intervention referral or conservative care.
Distinguish clinical infection from colonization and escalate danger features externally.

mappings.displayName: Avoid antibiotics for uninfected diabetic foot ulcer
mappings.learningObjective: Withhold antibiotics used solely for prevention or healing when clinical infection is absent.
Distinguish superficial partial-thickness from deeper thermal burns using wound findings.
Use burn and patient factors to select outpatient reassessment, consultation, or emergency transfer.
Recognize HS from lesion morphology, intertriginous distribution, and recurrence.
Refer recurrent or tunnel-forming HS for severity-based medical and procedural planning.
Recognize a parastomal hernia and identify uncertainty or obstruction.
Choose individualized external stoma and hernia care for a stable reducible parastomal hernia.
Recognize stoma prolapse and assess viability, reducibility, output, pain, and appliance function.
Send irreducible prolapse with ischemia or obstruction for urgent surgical evaluation.
Map documented eye, verbal, and motor responses and sum only when all are testable.
Record V-NT with its reason and avoid a misleading numeric total.
Recognize chronic secondary lymphedema while identifying changes that require another differential.
Refer stable established secondary lymphedema for individualized decongestive care.
Recognize a compatible neuropathic postherniorrhaphy pain pattern while reassessing recurrence and other causes.
Select targeted specialist block evaluation only when the chronic postherniorrhaphy pain pattern provides a plausible target.
Recognize a lateral semilunar-region Spigelian hernia and select imaging when examination is uncertain.
Refer a confirmed stable Spigelian hernia for individualized repair discussion while escalating urgent features.
Distinguish deep prosthetic mesh infection from a superficial postoperative skin process.
Arrange prompt specialist source-control evaluation without assuming universal mesh removal.
Use multidimensional liver, patient, procedure, and facility factors in perioperative cirrhosis assessment.
Pause a nonurgent elective plan for case-specific multidisciplinary optimization when active decompensation is present.
Recognize findings that warrant PTLD evaluation while preserving infection and rejection as mimics.
Coordinate transplant and hematology evaluation with tissue pathology rather than diagnosing PTLD from EBV DNA or imaging alone.

mappings.displayName: Map DTC with preoperative neck ultrasound
mappings.learningObjective: Select central and lateral neck ultrasonography after malignant thyroid cytology or molecular findings.
Plan lobectomy versus total thyroidectomy from disease extent and patient goals rather than one blanket rule.
Distinguish pathologic spontaneous unilateral single-duct discharge from physiologic bilateral multiduct expressed discharge.

mappings.displayName: Select diagnostic imaging for pathologic discharge
mappings.learningObjective: Select age- and context-appropriate diagnostic breast imaging for pathologic nipple discharge.
